A.TO_TIME, A.APPLY_LENGTH, AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID,A.ORDER_TIME) DAY_HOURS, CASE WHEN A.APPLY_TYPE_CODE = '141474' THEN GET_AR_LEAVE_LENGTH(HR.PERSON_ID, #interCpnyID:VARCHAR#, TO_DATE(FROM_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI'), TO_DATE(TO_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI'), '141474') || ' minutes' ELSE CASE WHEN A.APPLY_LENGTH >= AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID,A.ORDER_TIME) THEN CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(MOD(A.APPLY_LENGTH,AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID,A.ORDER_TIME))) || ' hours' ELSE TO_CHAR(TRUNC(A.APPLY_LENGTH/AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID,A.ORDER_TIME))) || ' days ' || TO_CHAR(MOD(A.APPLY_LENGTH,AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID,A.ORDER_TIME))) || ' hour' END ELSE TO_CHAR(TRUNC(A.APPLY_LENGTH/AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID,A.ORDER_TIME))) || ' days ' END ELSE CASE WHEN MOD(A.APPLY_LENGTH,AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID,A.ORDER_TIME)) > 0 THEN CASE WHEN MOD(A.APPLY_LENGTH,AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID,A.ORDER_TIME)) > 1 THEN TO_CHAR(TRUNC(A.APPLY_LENGTH/AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID,A.ORDER_TIME))) || ' day ' || TO_CHAR(MOD(A.APPLY_LENGTH,AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID,A.ORDER_TIME))) || ' hours' ELSE TO_CHAR(TRUNC(A.APPLY_LENGTH/AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID,A.ORDER_TIME))) || ' day ' || TO_CHAR(MOD(A.APPLY_LENGTH,AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID,A.ORDER_TIME))) || ' hour' END ELSE TO_CHAR(TRUNC(A.APPLY_LENGTH/AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID,A.ORDER_TIME))) || ' day ' END END ELSE CASE WHEN MOD(A.APPLY_LENGTH,AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID,A.ORDER_TIME)) > 0 THEN CASE WHEN MOD(A.APPLY_LENGTH,AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID,A.ORDER_TIME)) > 1 THEN TO_CHAR(MOD(A.APPLY_LENGTH,AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID,A.ORDER_TIME))) || ' hours' ELSE TO_CHAR(MOD(A.APPLY_LENGTH,AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID,A.ORDER_TIME))) || ' hour' END ELSE '0 hour' END END END ATT_LENGTH, CASE WHEN A.APPLY_LENGTH > 1 THEN A.APPLY_LENGTH || ' hours' ELSE A.APPLY_LENGTH || 'hour' END OT_LENGTH, A.REMARK, A.BATCH_YN, A.BATCH_NO, A.MISDOCID FROM (SELECT ATT.APPLY_NO, ATT.PERSON_ID, ATT.LEAVE_TYPE_NO APPLY_TYPE_NO, ATT.LEAVE_TYPE_CODE APPLY_TYPE_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(ATT.LEAVE_TYPE_CODE, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) APPLY_TYPE_NAME, TO_CHAR(ATT.APPLY_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY') APPLY_TIME, TO_CHAR(ATT.APPLY_TIME, 'YYYY/MM/DD') ORDER_TIME, TO_CHAR(ATT.LEAVE_FROM_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') FROM_TIME, TO_CHAR(ATT.LEAVE_TO_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') TO_TIME, ATT.APPLY_LENGTH, ATT.LEAVE_REASON REMARK, ATT.BATCH_YN, ATT.BATCH_NO, HH24:MI') TO_TIME, TO_NUMBER(CARD.WORK_HOUR) APPLY_LENGTH, CARD.APPLY_REASON REMARK, 0 BATCH_YN, 0 BATCH_NO, CARD.MISDOCID FROM ESS_CARD_APPLY_TB CARD WHERE CARD.AFFIRM_FLAG IN ('14014306','14014307') AND CARD.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND CARD.PERSON_ID IS NOT NULL AND CARD.ITEM_NO IS NOT NULL AND CARD.ACTIVITY = '1' AND CARD.CREATED_BY NOT LIKE '111111%' AND CARD.SEND_EMAIL_FLAG = 0 UNION SELECT S.SEQ, S.AFFIRM_TYPE, DECODE(S.AFFIRM_TYPE,4,0,1) ASSIGN_TYPE, S.APPLY_TYPE, S.APPLY_FLAG, E.EMPID AFFIRM_EMPID, (SELECT HR.EMAIL FROM HR_PERSONAL_INFO HR WHERE E.PERSON_ID = HR.PERSON_ID) EMAIL, S.AFFIRM_PERSON_ID, S.TITLE, S.AFFIRM_LEVEL, CASE WHEN S.APPLY_TYPE_CODE = '31' THEN TO_CHAR(DECODE(S.AFFIRM_TYPE,4,0,1)) ELSE S.AFFIRM_LEVEL END AFFIRM_LEVEL_FORMAT, (ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY S.AFFIRM_LEVEL)) - 1 ROW_LEVEL, S.AFFIRM_FLAG, S.APPLY_AFFIRM_FLAG, S.ACTIVITY FROM SY_AFFIRM_EMAIL S,HR_EMPLOYEE E WHERE S.AFFIRM_PERSON_ID = E.PERSON_ID AND S.APPLY_NO = #APPLY_NO# AND AFFIRM_TYPE <> 3 AND AFFIRM_FLAG = 0 ORDER BY S.AFFIRM_LEVEL

SELECT S.SEQ, S.AFFIRM_TYPE, DECODE(S.AFFIRM_TYPE,3,'referer','receiver') RECEIVER_TYPE, S.APPLY_TYPE, S.APPLY_FLAG, E.EMPID AFFIRM_EMPID, S.AFFIRM_PERSON_ID, S.TITLE, S.AFFIRM_LEVEL, (ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY S.AFFIRM_LEVEL)) - 1 ROW_LEVEL, S.AFFIRM_FLAG, S.APPLY_AFFIRM_FLAG, S.ACTIVITY FROM SY_AFFIRM_EMAIL S,HR_EMPLOYEE E WHERE S.AFFIRM_PERSON_ID = E.PERSON_ID AND S.APPLY_NO = #APPLY_NO# AND S.AFFIRM_TYPE IN (3,4) ORDER BY S.AFFIRM_LEVEL

REMARK FROM EDU_TRAINING_REGISTER A WHERE A.AFFIRM_FLAG = '14014310' AND A.SEND_EMAIL_FLAG = 1 AND A.APPLY_NO IN ($APPLY_NOS$)) A

SELECT * FROM (SELECT ATT.APPLY_NO, ATT.PERSON_ID, ATT.LEAVE_TYPE_NO APPLY_TYPE_NO, ATT.LEAVE_TYPE_CODE APPLY_TYPE_CODE, (CASE WHEN (TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(ATT.LEAVE_FROM_TIME,'HH24:MI'),'HH24:MI') > TO_DATE(SUBSTR(SUBSTR(GET_AR_SHIFT_TIME(GET_AR_SHIFTNO(ATT.PERSON_ID,TO_CHAR(ATT.LEAVE_FROM_TIME,'YYYY/MM/DD'),'HAE'), TO_CHAR(ATT.LEAVE_FROM_TIME,'YYYY/MM/DD'),'HAE','FIRST'),0,16),12,16),'HH24:MI')) THEN '1' ELSE '0' END) TIME_FLAG, ATT.BATCH_YN, ATT.BATCH_NO, ATT.MISDOCID FROM ESS_LEAVE_APPLY_TB ATT WHERE ATT.AFFIRM_FLAG NOT IN ('14014308', '14014309', '14014310') AND ATT.CPNY_ID = 'HAE' AND ATT.ACTIVITY = 1 AND ATT.SEND_EMAIL_FLAG = 1 AND ATT.MISDOCID IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT OT.APPLY_NO, OT.PERSON_ID, OT.OT_TYPE_NO APPLY_TYPE_NO, OT.OT_TYPE_CODE APPLY_TYPE_CODE, '0' TIME_FLAG, OT.BATCH_YN, OT.BATCH_NO, OT.MISDOCID FROM ESS_APPLY_OT OT WHERE OT.AFFIRM_FLAG NOT IN ('14014308', '14014309', '14014310') AND OT.CPNY_ID = 'HAE' AND OT.ACTIVITY = 1 AND OT.SEND_EMAIL_FLAG = 1 AND OT.MISDOCID IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT OTO.APPLY_NO, OTO.PERSON_ID, OTO.OT_TYPE_NO APPLY_TYPE_NO, OTO.OT_TYPE_CODE APPLY_TYPE_CODE, '0' TIME_FLAG, OTO.BATCH_YN, OTO.BATCH_NO, OTO.MISDOCID FROM ESS_APPLY_OT_OVER OTO WHERE OTO.AFFIRM_FLAG NOT IN ('14014308', '14014309', '14014310') AND OTO.CPNY_ID = 'HAE' AND OTO.ACTIVITY = 1 AND OTO.SEND_EMAIL_FLAG = 1 AND OTO.MISDOCID IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT CARD.APPLY_NO, CARD.PERSON_ID, '218197' APPLY_TYPE_NO, CARD.ITEM_NO APPLY_TYPE_CODE, '0' TIME_FLAG, 0 BATCH_YN, 0 BATCH_NO, CARD.MISDOCID FROM ESS_CARD_APPLY_TB CARD WHERE CARD.AFFIRM_FLAG NOT IN ('14014308', '14014309', '14014310') AND CARD.CPNY_ID = 'HAE' AND CARD.ACTIVITY = '1' AND CARD.SEND_EMAIL_FLAG = 1 AND CARD.MISDOCID IS NOT NULL) A ORDER BY A.APPLY_NO
